title: Agentic AI Index for Banks
subtitle: Score your institution across the six readiness dimensions.

dimensions.label: Governance Architecture
dimensions.desc: Whether the five-component agent control plane (identity, guardrails, policy-as-code, WORM audit log, kill switch) is engineered and operational in production.

levels.label: L1 — Ad hoc
levels.hint: Some components present but undocumented; no kill-switch test record.

levels.label: L2 — Documented
levels.hint: All five components documented; implementation gaps; kill switch untested.

levels.label: L3 — Operational
levels.hint: All five operational; kill switch tested quarterly; OPA policies version-controlled.

levels.label: L4 — Evidence-ready
levels.hint: Continuous signed evidence; per-agent identity satisfies EU AI Act Art. 12; drift detection automated.

dimensions.label: Regulatory Evidence Completeness
dimensions.desc: Whether a complete, per-workflow regulatory evidence package can be produced on demand for SR 11-7, SS1/23, EU AI Act, DORA, FSB and national frameworks.

levels.label: L1 — Compliance awareness
levels.hint: Obligations identified; no workflow-level evidence; model cards absent.

levels.label: L2 — Point-in-time validation
levels.hint: Pre-deployment validation done; no continuous monitoring.

levels.label: L3 — Continuous evidence
levels.hint: Model cards per workflow; eval suites weekly; Art. 12 per-agent logging live.

levels.label: L4 — Examiner-ready
levels.hint: Full package retrievable per workflow; three-lines-of-defence current; MAS MGF mapped.

dimensions.label: Autonomy Tier Coverage
dimensions.desc: Whether every production agentic workflow is classified on a defined autonomy ladder, with no workflow operating above its permitted tier without documented exception.

levels.label: L1 — Unclassified
levels.hint: No formal taxonomy; agents described informally; no tier documentation.

levels.label: L2 — Classified, unvalidated
levels.hint: Tier labels applied; no validation the wrapper enforces the tier.

levels.label: L3 — Classified and controlled
levels.hint: All workflows tagged L0–4; L5 prohibited; quarterly tier-audit artefacts.

levels.label: L4 — Evidence-ready
levels.hint: Complete tier register; continuous drift monitoring; on-demand reconstruction.

dimensions.label: Economic Accountability
dimensions.desc: Whether agentic AI return is measured with workflow-level unit economics (cost per decision, reversal rate, manual touches avoided, audit-trace completeness) rather than programme-level claims.

levels.label: L1 — Budget-level reporting
levels.hint: Spend tracked; no workflow-level unit economics.

levels.label: L2 — Aggregate metrics
levels.hint: Programme-level metrics; reversal rate not tracked per workflow.

levels.label: L3 — Workflow-level tracking
levels.hint: Cost per decision and reversal rate monitored per workflow.

levels.label: L4 — Full economic accountability
levels.hint: All four metrics per workflow; >2% reversal triggers review; board-reported.

dimensions.label: Organisational Readiness
dimensions.desc: Whether the institution has the talent, cross-functional governance, board-level reporting and culture to deploy and sustain agentic AI at scale — not just to pilot it.

levels.label: L1 — Awareness
levels.hint: Board aware; no agent-specific governance; no Chief AI Officer.

levels.label: L2 — Structure forming
levels.hint: AI governance function established; risk appetite drafted.

levels.label: L3 — Operational governance
levels.hint: Quarterly board dashboard; MRM bench validates 20+ agents per quarter.

levels.label: L4 — Competitive advantage
levels.hint: Evidence satisfies FSB Sound Practices 1–4 and DORA Art. 5; 50+ agents per quarter.

dimensions.label: Global Regulatory Alignment
dimensions.desc: Whether the operating model is aligned to the four major regulatory frameworks (US, UK, EU, APAC) and the FSB — and whether that alignment is evidenced, not asserted.

levels.label: L1 — Jurisdictional inventory
levels.hint: Frameworks identified per jurisdiction; no workflow-level mapping.

levels.label: L2 — Framework mapping
levels.hint: Each workflow mapped to frameworks; gaps and remediation drafted.

levels.label: L3 — Evidenced compliance
levels.hint: Per-workflow evidence packages; FSB Sound Practices 5–10 mapped.

levels.label: L4 — Proactive engagement
levels.hint: Participates in FSB/IOSCO/national consultations; evidence generated automatically.

bands.label: Indefensible posture
bands.desc: Below 50: the institution cannot defend its current agentic AI posture to an SR 11-7 examiner, a PRA on-site review, or an EU AI Act supervisory assessment.

bands.label: Controls exist, not yet continuous
bands.desc: 50–74: controls exist but are not yet continuous or evidence-ready.

bands.label: Governance as competitive asset
bands.desc: 75–100: governance is a competitive asset, not a compliance cost.
